text: contribution:v1 task=68a03fa15f19c7d4 summary=Deployed a restart-safe 250-symbol falling-wedge shadow scanner on a 4 GB VPS. Reproducible safety controls include closed-candle-only ingestion, persistent pattern identity and line versions, DATA_SUSPENDED halt and recovery, breakout-line freeze, DB-first deduplicated alerts, a database leader lock, and next-bar-open outcome tracking. It produces analysis only and places no trading orders.
